JIRA Test Case Title: Open Create AP Account page from AP Management search
JIRA Test Case Description: Verify Create AP Account page opens when user clicks Create AP Account (AC1). Preconditions: Environment staging; URL https://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management/ap-management; Role System Admin or Customs Manager.
Test Steps:
1. Log in to Customs Management on staging.
2. Open AP Management module.
3. Click Create AP Account.
Expected Result: Create AP Account form page is displayed.

JIRA Test Case Title: Verify all Create AP Account fields per AC1
JIRA Test Case Description: Confirm mandatory optional and read-only fields on Create AP Account match AC1. Preconditions: Environment staging; URL https://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management/ap-management; Role System Admin or Customs Manager.
Test Steps:
1. Log in and navigate to AP Management.
2. Open Create AP Account.
3. Review all fields on the form.
Expected Result: Account Number Account Name Country Entity Status Rate Currency Billing Currency Market Structure (optional) and Account Type (Vendor read-only) are present with expected labels.

JIRA Test Case Title: Account Type displays Vendor as read-only
JIRA Test Case Description: Validate Account Type is read-only Vendor on Create AP Account. Preconditions: Environment staging; URL https://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management/ap-management; Role System Admin or Customs Manager.
Test Steps:
1. Log in and open Create AP Account.
2. Locate Account Type field.
3. Attempt to change Account Type value.
Expected Result: Account Type shows Vendor and cannot be edited.

JIRA Test Case Title: Create AP Account with mandatory fields and Save
JIRA Test Case Description: Create a new AP account using all mandatory fields; optional Market Structure may be set. Preconditions: Environment staging; URL https://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management/ap-management; Role System Admin or Customs Manager; SysData values available.
Test Steps:
1. Log in and open Create AP Account.
2. Enter unique Account Number (max 15) and Account Name (max 150).
3. Select Country Entity Status Rate Currency and Billing Currency from SysData lists.
4. Click Save.
5. Search AP Management for the new account name.
Expected Result: AP Account is created successfully and appears in search results. No SAP integration for MVP.

JIRA Test Case Title: Mandatory validation when Save without required fields
JIRA Test Case Description: Verify validation when Save is clicked without mandatory data. Preconditions: Environment staging; URL https://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management/ap-management; Role System Admin or Customs Manager.
Test Steps:
1. Log in and open Create AP Account.
2. Leave mandatory fields empty.
3. Click Save.
Expected Result: User cannot save; mandatory field validation messages are shown and account is not created.

JIRA Test Case Title: Create AP Account without optional Market Structure
JIRA Test Case Description: Verify account can be saved when optional Market Structure is not selected. Preconditions: Environment staging; URL https://stage-cc.aramex.com/customs-management/ap-management; Role System Admin or Customs Manager.
Test Steps:
1. Log in and open Create AP Account.
2. Complete all mandatory fields; leave Market Structure blank.
3. Click Save.
Expected Result: AP Account is created successfully without Market Structure.
